pages.title: Unowned Stardust
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Creative inventory.$(br2)§lUse: §r Stores and releases tamed girls.$(br)Right-click a tamed girl with an empty Unowned Stardust to take her in; right-click a block to let her out again.$(br2)Only girls that belong to you can be stored. While a girl is inside, the item glows with an enchantment shimmer.
